  AC2 (swiftroute-shipment-high-value-happy) → test 'dispatcher -> ops-approve -> CEO co-sign; 4 expected_outcomes with evidence'. Asserts: 5 step_results all :ok; eo1.outcome in [:pass,:fail] with eo1.observed.assignee_ref=="role-ceo" (settled-OQ-3 evidence); eo2.outcome==:pass (COMPLETED); eo3.outcome==:pass (variables); eo4.outcome==:pass (audit_event task.complete). Non-trivial: any engine error propagates as :error step outcome, causing assertion failure.
  AC3 (swiftroute-shipment-ops-timeout-escalation) → test 'step 1 :ok, step 2 :skip/:minor (advance-timer absent), step 3 :ok'. Asserts: 3 step_results; step2.outcome==:skip; step2.severity==:minor; step2.detail=~"advance-timer"; both outcome_results :pass. Non-trivial: if Runner SKIP logic changes, step2 assertions fail.
  AC4 (swiftroute-shipment-attach-delivery-note) → test 'disposition :unbuilt_feature; zero steps executed; R-Co evidence in notes'.   AC6 (mix test + compile pass) → mix test test/letflow/simulation/req206_swiftroute_test.exs: 'Finished in 14.6 seconds / Result: 6 passed'. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: exit 0, no output (files already current, 0 warnings).
